usedFor: iContact keeps your email lists, and “Contact Subscribed” and “New Contact” tell you when someone joins.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Contact” in iContact
bestTemplate.why: A buyer becomes a contact, so they can join your email lists after the sale.

watchOut: “New Message” and “New Contact in List” are checked on a schedule, so expect a short delay.
